necessary_context.content: Minimize F(x)=f(x)+Psi(x) on R^N. f is smooth convex; Psi is proper closed convex extended-real-valued and block separable. A finite attained minimum F* exists. Use x0 in dom Psi. The p.4 formulation supplies the extended-real convention used for constraints.
necessary_context.name: Composite objective and standing assumptions

necessary_context.content: U=[U1,...,Un] is a column permutation of I_N, Ui has Ni columns, sum Ni=N, x^(i)=Ui^T x. Each Bi is positive definite; ||t||_(i)^2=<Bi t,t>, ||s||*_(i)^2=<Bi^(-1)s,s>. For every x in R^N, t in R^Ni and i, ||nabla_i f(x+Ui t)-nabla_i f(x)||*_(i)<=Li||t||_(i), Li>0. Psi(x)=sum Psi_i(x^(i)).
necessary_context.name: Block geometry and smoothness

necessary_context.content: ||x||_L^2=sum_i Li||x^(i)||_(i)^2; X*=argmin F. The source defines R_L(x0)=max_y max_{x* in X*}{||y-x*||_L : F(y)<=F(x0)}. This ranges over all minimizers, rather than the nearest minimizer. Theorem 4(i) uses finite R_L(x0) and Delta0=F(x0)-F*>0.
necessary_context.locator: §2, PDF p.8, Eq.(11) and unnumbered radius definition; §3.1, PDF pp.11–12
necessary_context.name: Global norm and level-set radius
